fields.title: 📖 aṭ-Ṭabarī: They replaced and altered Allah’s judgment
fields.body:
🖋️ **aṭ-Ṭabarī:**

> ***“Those who are rebuked did not judge by what Allah had sent down in His Book; they replaced and altered His judgment, concealed the truth, showed the people something else, and judged by that.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This is not the case of a mere wrong judgment out of weakness, but the case of Taḥrīf and Tabdīl: Allah’s judgment is pushed aside and another judgment is put in its place.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī, Jāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44.
